items.name: argenx SE
items.take: Total operating income was $1,751M versus $1,151M; diluted EPS was $7.80 versus $5.18.

items.name: Abbott Laboratories
items.take: Net sales were $13,013M versus $11,369M; diluted EPS was $0.53 GAAP versus $0.94 and $1.42 adjusted versus $1.30.

items.name: Globe Life
items.take: Total revenue was $1,595.9M versus $1,513.0M; net operating income per diluted share was $4.84 versus $4.81.

items.name: Old National Bancorp
items.take: Net income applicable to common shares was $250.0M versus $178.5M; total revenue (FTE) was $720.4M versus $713.0M.

items.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
items.take: Revenue grew 9% to $12.14B with 6% organic growth; GAAP diluted EPS was $4.64 and adjusted EPS $6.68.

items.name: Teledyne Technologies
items.take: Net sales were $1,684.9M; GAAP diluted EPS $5.82 vs. $4.65, with full-year 2026 GAAP EPS outlook raised to $21.71-$21.87.

items.name: Las Vegas Sands
items.take: Net revenue was $3.22B vs. $3.33B and adjusted property EBITDA $1.12B vs. $1.34B; $950M of stock repurchased and 2027 dividend raised 20%.
items.source_name: Las Vegas Sands Q3 2026 earnings release

items.name: Medpace Holdings
items.take: Revenue was $716.0M and backlog $3,167.2M, up 5.6%; 2026 revenue forecast at $2.835-$2.855B.

items.name: Meta Platforms
items.take: Revenue rose to $64.6B and diluted EPS was $3.83, with costs including a $9.89B charge tied to an agreement with state attorneys general; Q4 revenue guided to $73-$76B.

items.name: Tesla
items.take: Revenue was $28,046M versus $28,095M a year earlier; GAAP EPS was $0.22 versus $0.39, and free cash flow was $1,531M versus $3,990M.

items.name: IBM
items.take: Revenue rose to $17.1B with Software at $7.8B; operating EPS was $2.95 versus $2.65, and the full-year free cash flow outlook was raised.

items.name: Texas Instruments
items.take: Revenue rose 28% from a year ago and 11% sequentially; fourth-quarter guidance is revenue of $5.80-$6.30B and EPS of $2.45-$2.79.

items.name: CSX
items.take: Revenue was up 12% on 5% higher volume; the prior-year quarter included a $164M goodwill impairment, and excluding it prior-year EPS was $0.44.

items.name: Reliance
items.take: Record net sales; non-GAAP EPS was $8.02 versus $3.64 and tons sold rose 15.6% from a year ago.

items.name: RTX
items.take: Organic sales grew 12% and adjusted EPS rose to $2.26 from $1.70 on a $340 billion backlog; the 2026 adjusted EPS outlook was raised to $7.65-$7.75.

items.name: GE Aerospace
items.take: Orders rose 49% to $19.0 billion and adjusted EPS to $2.25 from $1.66; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $8.00-$8.10 from $7.65-$7.85.
items.source_name: GE Aerospace Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99)

items.name: Northrop Grumman
items.take: Backlog climbed to $109.6 billion from $95.7 billion at year-end 2025, and 2026 MTM-adjusted EPS guidance rose to $29.35-$29.75.
items.source_name: Northrop Grumman Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99)

items.name: 3M
items.take: Adjusted organic growth was 3.3% and adjusted EPS $2.50 versus $2.23; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is $9.10-$9.15.

items.name: AT&T
items.take: Adjusted EPS rose to $0.65 from $0.54; diluted EPS fell on a non-cash impairment tied to the held-for-sale Mexico wireless business, and the 2026 outlook calls for free cash flow of $18 billion-plus.

items.name: Fifth Third Bancorp
items.take: Adjusted EPS was $1.13 excluding $0.23 of items, including $171 million of after-tax merger charges as the Comerica systems conversion was completed; revenue shown is total revenue on an FTE basis.
items.source_name: Fifth Third Bancorp Q3 2026 earnings release

items.name: Travelers Companies
items.take: Net income rose to $1.917 billion from $1.888 billion and core EPS to $9.18 from $8.14 as the combined ratio improved to 86.8% from 87.3%, despite catastrophe losses of $538 million versus $402 million; net written premiums were flat at $11.48 billion.

items.name: Truist Financial
items.take: GAAP revenue fell to $3.75 billion from $5.19 billion on a $1.4 billion pretax loss from AFS securities sales; adjusted EPS excluding that loss, a $581 million reserve recapture and RAC loan-sale impacts was $1.16 versus $1.04.

items.name: Citizens Financial Group
items.take: Net interest income rose to $1,675 million from $1,488 million as the margin widened to 3.18% from 2.99%, and the provision fell to $125 million from $154 million.
items.source_name: Citizens Financial Q3 2026 financial supplement (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.3)

items.name: Regions Financial
items.take: Regions said diluted EPS rose 16% from a year earlier (the release does not state the prior-year figure); net charge-offs fell to 0.29% of average loans from 0.55%.

items.name: First Horizon
items.take: GAAP total revenue fell to $407 million from $889 million because of a $473 million pretax loss on about $4.5 billion of mortgages moved to held for sale; adjusted EPS excluding notable items was $0.53 versus $0.51 a year earlier.
items.source_name: First Horizon Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Interactive Brokers
items.take: Reported net revenues of $1.91 billion versus $1.66 billion, with net interest income up 19% to $1.15 billion and a 78% pretax margin; the quarterly dividend rises to $0.15 from $0.0875.

items.name: J.B. Hunt Transport Services
items.take: Revenue grew 20% on intermodal and brokerage volume, but operating income rose only 2% to $247.1 million as Dedicated and Final Mile margins compressed.

items.name: Alcoa
items.take: Net income attributable to Alcoa rose to $483 million from $232 million a year earlier, though revenue and adjusted EBITDA ($789 million) fell from Q2; 2026 production guidance was reaffirmed.

items.name: Charles Schwab
items.take: Record net revenues and core net new assets of $190.4 billion; net interest revenue rose to $3.476 billion and the GAAP pre-tax margin widened to 52.7% from 49.2%.
items.correction: Source link changed from a third-party repost (stockhouse.com) to Schwab's own earnings release; figures unchanged.

items.name: Prologis
items.take: Total revenues rose to $2.388 billion from $2.214 billion, and core FFO rose to $1.60 a share from $1.49. Prologis narrowed 2026 core FFO guidance to $6.25–$6.29 and cut net EPS guidance to $4.05–$4.15.

items.name: UnitedHealth Group
items.take: Revenues slipped to $112.694 billion from $113.161 billion, but the medical care ratio improved to 88.4% from 89.9% and adjusted EPS rose to $4.69 from $2.92. The company raised its 2026 outlook to at least $19.50 of EPS and at least $20.50 adjusted.

items.name: Marsh
items.take: Revenue rose to $6.863 billion from $6.351 billion with 5% underlying growth, led by Consulting (up 9%, 8% underlying) while Risk & Insurance Services grew 3% underlying. Adjusted EPS rose 10% to $2.03, and the company bought back $500 million of stock in the quarter.

items.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.take: Revenue and EPS are in New Taiwan dollars (NT$ billions; diluted EPS NT$29.43, or US$4.60 per ADR); US$ revenue was $46.72 billion. TSMC guided Q4 revenue to US$52.3B–$54.3B with a 65%–67% gross margin.

items.name: PNC Financial Services
items.take: Net interest income rose 15% to $4.21 billion; adjusted EPS was $5.09 excluding FirstBank integration costs and net significant items. CET1 was an estimated 9.8%.
items.source_name: PNC Financial Services Group, Q3 2026 earnings release

items.name: U.S. Bancorp
items.take: Revenue is total net revenue on a taxable-equivalent basis as reported. Noninterest income rose 13.1% and the efficiency ratio improved to 55.9%; provision included a $135 million initial charge for an acquired card portfolio.

items.name: BNY
items.take: Fee revenue rose 12% and net interest income 15%; AUC/A reached $63.4 trillion. Pre-tax margin was 38.5% and ROTCE 29.0%.

items.name: Ericsson
items.take: Figures are in Swedish kronor (net sales SEK 59.478 billion; diluted EPS SEK 1.77). Organic sales rose 7%; prior-year EPS included a SEK 1.72 per share divestment gain.
items.source_name: Ericsson Q3 2026 report (company release via PR Newswire)

items.name: Johnson & Johnson
items.take: Sales rose 5.9% on 7.7% Innovative Medicine growth, but diluted EPS fell to $0.09 on special items including a one-time charge for the proposed talc litigation resolution; adjusted EPS was $2.59. J&J raised 2026 guidance to $101.0B–$101.4B of sales and $11.05–$11.15 of adjusted EPS.

items.name: Domino's Pizza
items.take: U.S. same-store sales grew 0.3% and international comps 0.2% ex-FX, with global retail sales up 3.2% ex-FX on 175 net new stores.

items.name: JPMorgan Chase
items.take: Net income rose 6% to $15.3 billion as net interest income grew 13% and the credit provision fell to $2.7 billion from $3.4 billion. Results included a $658 million investment securities loss; ROTCE was 20%, or 21% excluding it.

items.name: Bank of America
items.take: Net income fell to $6.93 billion from $8.33 billion, including a $1.2 billion charge for civil money penalties tied to Bank Secrecy Act consent orders. Revenue still grew about 3%, so the EPS decline is a compliance cost rather than an operating slowdown.

items.name: Wells Fargo
items.take: Net income rose to $5.95 billion from $5.59 billion. EPS growth well ahead of roughly 2% revenue growth reflects buybacks and cost control more than top-line momentum.

items.name: Citigroup
items.take: Net income of $5.2 billion versus $3.8 billion a year earlier, with RoTCE of 11.5% and a 12.8% CET1 ratio. The EPS comparison is flattered by a Banamex-related goodwill impairment in the prior-year quarter.

items.name: State Street
items.take: Net income rose to $1.09 billion from $861 million. Double-digit revenue growth with EPS up by about a third shows strong operating leverage in the custody model.

items.name: BlackRock
items.take: GAAP diluted EPS rose to $10.57 from $8.43, and as-adjusted diluted EPS rose to $15.93 from $11.55. Revenue growth near 19% shows fee income compounding on both flows and higher asset levels.

items.name: Fastenal
items.take: Net earnings rose to $401.6 million from $335.5 million. Mid-teens sales growth at an industrial distributor is a constructive read on U.S. factory and construction activity.

items.name: Morgan Stanley
items.take: Net income of $4.9 billion versus $4.6 billion a year ago, with a 22.6% return on tangible common equity. Revenue growth outpaced EPS growth, and both rose from a year earlier.
items.correction: Corrected revenue_yoy from 11.5 to 11.6 ($20,338M vs $18,224M per the earnings release).

items.name: Goldman Sachs
items.take: Net earnings of $5.29 billion and an 18.7% annualized ROE. Global Banking & Markets produced $13.46 billion, about 72% of net revenues, so the quarter rests on trading and dealmaking.
